description: This Java class defines a REST API resource for integrating with credit bureau systems. It handles operations such as fetching credit reports, uploading credit reports, saving credit report data, retrieving saved reports, and deleting reports. The class uses JAX-RS annotations for mapping endpoints, along with Swagger annotations for API documentation, and interacts with service layers for processing credit bureau data.

classes.name: CreditBureauIntegrationApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for interacting with credit bureau data, including fetching, uploading, saving, retrieving, and deleting credit reports.

methods.name: fetchCreditReport
methods.description: Handles POST requests to fetch credit reports based on provided parameters.

methods.name: addCreditReport
methods.description: Handles POST requests to upload and add a new credit report file to the system.

methods.name: saveCreditReport
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update credit report data into the database.

methods.name: getSavedCreditReport
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve saved credit report data for a specific credit bureau.

methods.name: deleteCreditReport
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a credit report from the system.
